description:
Simulated, not a forecast: 4,000 paths resampled from one portfolio's own
        price history, with optional monthly additions; where the middle path
        and the outer tenths end after the years asked, in money and in
        today's money, and the share of paths ending below what was put in. It
        assumes the future pays what the record paid, and it is refused when
        the record is too short or too extreme for the years asked.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

haircut.description: Yearly return removed from every path, as a fraction (0.02 = assume 2% a year less than the record paid).
haircut.title: Haircut

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: weight or amount}. Weights need not sum to one; amounts in the base currency are also accepted (then the crises are shown in money). 1 to 100 holdings. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash).
holdings.title: Holdings

monthly.description: Amount added every month, in the base currency.
monthly.title: Monthly

years.description: Years to run the paths, 1 to 40.
years.title: Years

name: simulate_paths

outputSchema.description: Paths resampled from the record (SIMULATED), or the reasons they were refused.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

assumption.description: The assumption every path rests on.

bands.description: Percentile paths over time: p5 … p95, aligned with `years`.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

extrapolation.description: Years asked divided by years of history.

historical_cagr.description: Growth per year the record paid.

invested.description: Money put in over the years asked.

prob_below_invested.description: Share of paths ending below what was put in (a share of simulated paths, not a probability of the future).

refused.description: Present when no paths were drawn: the reasons, in words.

sample_years.description: Years of shared history the paths are drawn from.

terminal.description: Where the paths end, by percentile: p5, p10, p25, p50, p75, p90, p95.

years.description: Time axis of the bands, in years.

youngest.description: When refused: the holding whose short history cut the record.

title: Paths drawn from the record (simulated)
